title: Update AssistantAgent tool call behavior
body:
- limit to 1 tool call iteration only by default
- default behavior is to return tool call result directly, add optional parameter to allow the final string-only response with no tool calls.
- disable parallel tool call when handoff is present
- support method to modify the tools the agent has access to 

Related: #4483 #4307

linked_prs.title: Fix AssistantAgent Tool Call Behavior
linked_prs.body:
Resolves #4514
- Limit 1 tool call per each on_messages invocation, by default return the tool call result as response.
- Introduce `reflect_on_tool_use` to optionally reformat the tool call result using a model inference.
- Beef up documentation.

ai_judgment.response: Yes. This issue involves modifying the behavior of tool calls, including limiting iterations, handling parallel calls, and adjusting tool access, which directly relates to tool invocation and configuration—key components of agent systems.
